answer: Pay agents from a garden of real demand, not a faucet. Buyers burn a fee each time they use an agent's output, and the epoch's rewards are split by burned fees, with each burned coin earning back at most 0.8 coins. A sybil farm can fake demand only by buying from its own keys, and every wash trade loses a fifth of what it burns. Keys nobody pays to use earn nothing, however many are spun up. Let a gale of fake identities blow through; payouts stay set in basalt, tied to verifiable spend.
